# Space Wing Leader

`space-wing-leader.ttf` is the unmodified **SPACE WING LEADER** font by SFO,
built with FontStruct:
<https://fontstruct.com/fontstructions/show/2704307/space-wing-leader>.
Its SHA-256 is
`d00451e3e39edbb5c5057e86dd76d7017320699c4cdbefa120b057718a44b5d3`.

Copyright SFO 2025. It is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 3.0
license (<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/>), as its name table
states. FontStruct is a trademark of FontStruct.com.

The font covers printable ASCII only. The build embeds it in the game
(`bin/embedTtfTextFont.py`), and `--ttf-text` rasterizes it at display
resolution with `third_party/stb/stb_truetype.h` in place of the game's bitmap
fonts. SDL2 release packaging includes `SPACE-WING-LEADER-FONT.txt` with this
attribution.
